description: Ethernet PHY driver for SiLabs Giant Gecko GG11, including functions for PHY initialization, auto-negotiation, link status, and MDIO bus control.

methods.name: mdio_bus_enable
methods.description: Enables the MDIO serial bus between MAC and PHY.

methods.name: mdio_bus_disable
methods.description: Disables the MDIO serial bus between MAC and PHY.

methods.name: mdio_bus_wait
methods.description: Waits for PHY operation to complete with a timeout.

methods.name: mdio_bus_send
methods.description: Sends a command to PHY over MDIO serial bus.

methods.name: phy_soft_reset
methods.description: Issues a soft reset to the PHY.

methods.name: phy_gecko_init
methods.description: Initializes the PHY device, performs soft reset and ID check.

methods.name: phy_gecko_auto_negotiate
methods.description: Performs auto-negotiation and updates link status.

methods.name: phy_gecko_is_linked
methods.description: Checks if the PHY link is active.
